interest: a reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and shows the department innovates

interest: a well-run project that meets the course goals and delivers a working pilot
expectation: Expects the sponsor to approve the charter in week 1 and to attend the week-7 and week-13 gate reviews.

role: Developers and testers (backend, real-time, frontend, QA/DevOps)
interest: a working product, a good grade and portfolio experience with Spring Boot and WebSocket
expectation: Expects a clear scope, a stable 8 h per week workload and a decision from the PM within a week when a change is requested.

interest: quick, fun and reliable live quizzes with instant feedback
expectation: Expect to join a live session with a 6-character code and see their score and the leaderboard instantly in week 14.

interest: less marking time and easy quiz authoring
expectation: Expect to create a quiz in a few minutes, run a live session and export the results to CSV or PDF by the pilot.

interest: no surprises at go-live, a runbook and a backup job
expectation: Expects a deployment checklist and the docker-compose.prod.yml two weeks before the pilot.

role: Controls the campus proxy and Wi-Fi
interest: no unusual traffic or blocked ports causing network problems
expectation: Expects a note describing the WebSocket traffic and the load test date before the week-12 test.

role: Owns the capstone and its assessment
interest: a project that meets the course standards and learning outcomes
expectation: Expects the lab deliverables and the Git history to show steady work from every team member.

interest: student names and results stored on campus with a retention rule
expectation: Expects a one-page data description before the pilot and can block the pilot without it.

interest: a proven tool the faculty can adopt without extra cost
expectation: Expects a short pilot report in week 14 with results, costs and a recommendation.

role: Alternative supplier (option B in the business case)
expectation: Expects nothing now; becomes relevant only if the week-7 demo fails and option B is bought.
